Plain output is split into disjoint parts of at most 1 MiB (base64 output plus normal job overhead stays below the 2 MiB target). A separate index part contains hashes for all other parts. Root must verify all part indexes, lengths, hashes and reconstructed file hashes. No original Quality/Security artifact-download verification is claimed by this new run.
